Anant Singh & Anand Mohan:purv sansad aanand mohan ko lekar siyasi aur kanuni halchal tej ho gaee hai... aaj saharsa men aanand mohan apne paitrik ganv panchagchhiya pahunche...yahan bhagavti sthan mandir men puja-archana ki... graminon ke sath baithak ki aur samarthakon se aashirvad liya... lekin 1994 ke charchit ji krishnaiya hatyakand men khud ko aaj bhi nirdosh bataya...dusri or kal patna men aanand mohan ke bete vidhayak chetan aanand ne samarthakon aur yuvaon ki aapat baithak bulaee hai...riport dekhie..
